register.labelZh: PICK 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: pick out 可以表示從一群人或事物中作出選擇,也可以表示辨認聲音、形狀、細節或重點。；你可以使用 PICK 片語動詞談論抱起孩子、拿起袋子,或乘車接載某人。；pick up on something 可以表示察覺某種感受、暗示或變化;pick somebody up on something 則可以表示指出某人的錯誤。；pick up 可以表示生意好轉;pick up speed 或 momentum 可以表示進展加快;pick up the pieces則可以表示在困難過後收拾殘局,重新開始。
register.summaryEn: Pick out can help you choose one person or thing from a group. It can also help you describe recognising a voice, shape, detail or important point. You can use PICK expressions to talk about lifting a child, taking a bag or collecting somebody by car or bus. Pick up on something can describe noticing a feeling, hint or change. Pick somebody up on something can describe pointing out an error. Pick up can show that business is improving. Pick up speed or momentum describes faster progress, while pick up the pieces describes starting again after a difficult event.
